description: This file defines a generic Data Access Object (DAO) class for SQLAlchemy models in the Superset project, including filtering, querying, and CRUD operations, with support for complex filters and relationships.

classes.name: ColumnOperatorEnum
classes.description: Enumeration of supported filter operators for columns, with an apply method to generate filter expressions.

classes.name: ColumnOperator
classes.description: Pydantic model representing a filter condition on a column, including column name, operator, and value.

classes.name: BaseDAO
classes.description: A generic Data Access Object class providing CRUD, filtering, and querying capabilities for SQLAlchemy models, supporting complex filters, relationships, and pagination.

methods.name: find_by_id_or_uuid
methods.description: Finds a record by its ID or UUID, applying base filters if configured.

methods.name: _apply_base_filter
methods.description: Applies the base filter to a query unless skipped.

methods.name: _convert_value_for_column
methods.description: Converts a value to the appropriate type for a given SQLAlchemy column, e.g., UUIDs.

methods.name: _find_by_column
methods.description: Finds a record by a specific column value.

methods.name: find_by_id
methods.description: Finds a record by its ID, with optional custom ID column.

methods.name: find_by_ids
methods.description: Finds multiple records by a list of IDs, with conversion and filtering.

methods.name: find_all
methods.description: Retrieves all records matching the base filter.

methods.name: find_one_or_none
methods.description: Retrieves the first record matching filters or None.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new record from an object or attributes.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing record with new attributes.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes a query based on a SQLAlchemy Query object.

methods.name: apply_column_operators
methods.description: Applies a list of column-based filters to a query.

methods.name: get_filterable_columns_and_operators
methods.description: Returns a dict of columns and their supported filter operators.

methods.name: _build_query
methods.description: Constructs a query with filters, search, sorting, and relationships.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a paginated, sorted, and filtered list of records, with optional columns and relationship loading.
